result.instructions: Tools for Discourse, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What are the latest topics on our community forum?"; "Search the forum for posts about the refund policy."; "Reply to the topic about the beta release and thank the reporter.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Discourse data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run discourse_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run discourse_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run discourse_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. discourse_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: discourse_search
tools.title: Search the forum
tools.description: Search topics, posts, users and categories of the forum for a term. Returns matching posts and topics with their ids. Discourse API: GET /search.json?q=.

query.description: Search term; supports Discourse search syntax such as in:title or #category.

tools.name: discourse_list_latest_topics
tools.title: List latest topics
tools.description: List the latest topics of the forum, newest activity first by default. Discourse API: GET /latest.json.

tools.name: discourse_list_top_topics
tools.title: List top topics
tools.description: List the top topics of the forum for a period. Discourse API: GET /top.json.

tools.name: discourse_get_topic
tools.title: Get a topic
tools.description: Get one topic with its title, category, tags and the first posts of its post stream. Discourse API: GET /t/{id}.json.

tools.name: discourse_get_post
tools.title: Get a post
tools.description: Get one post with its raw Markdown, author and cooked HTML. Discourse API: GET /posts/{id}.json.

tools.name: discourse_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List the categories of the forum with their ids, slugs and colours. Discourse API: GET /categories.json.

tools.name: discourse_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags of the forum with their topic counts. Discourse API: GET /tags.json.

tools.name: discourse_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get a user's profile by username: name, trust level, groups and activity counts. Discourse API: GET /u/{username}.json.

tools.name: discourse_list_notifications
tools.title: List notifications
tools.description: List the notifications of the user the key acts as: replies, mentions, likes and messages. Discourse API: GET /notifications.json.

tools.name: discourse_list_private_messages
tools.title: List private messages
tools.description: List the private message topics received by a user. Discourse API: GET /topics/private-messages/{username}.json.

tools.name: discourse_get_site_info
tools.title: Get site info
tools.description: Get the forum's basic information: title, description, logo and version. Discourse API: GET /site/basic-info.json.

tools.name: discourse_create_topic
tools.title: Create a topic
tools.description: Create a new public topic in a category as the key's user. Publishes content on the forum: confirm the text first. Discourse API: POST /posts.json.

tools.name: discourse_reply_to_topic
tools.title: Reply to a topic
tools.description: Post a reply in an existing topic as the key's user. Publishes content on the forum: confirm the text first. Discourse API: POST /posts.json.

tools.name: discourse_mark_notifications_read
tools.title: Mark notifications read
tools.description: Mark all notifications of the key's user as read, or one notification by id. Discourse API: PUT /notifications/mark-read.json.

id.description: Notification id; omit to mark all as read.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Discourse
prompts.description: What you can do with Discourse here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: search_the_forum_and_read_matching_topics
prompts.title: Search the forum and read matching topics
prompts.description: Search topics, posts, users and categories for a term. Open a matching topic to read its title, category and first posts.

prompts.name: catch_up_on_the_latest_and_top_topics
prompts.title: Catch up on the latest and top topics
prompts.description: List the latest topics, or the top topics for a period. Read one post with its raw Markdown to see the exact wording.

prompts.name: reply_to_a_topic
prompts.title: Reply to a topic
prompts.description: Read a topic, then post a reply in it as the key owner. The reply is published on the forum when you post it, so check the text first.

prompts.name: start_a_new_topic_in_a_category
prompts.title: Start a new topic in a category
prompts.description: List the categories and tags, then create a public topic in one category. The topic is published on the forum when it is created.

prompts.name: review_notifications_and_private_messages
prompts.title: Review notifications and private messages
prompts.description: List the notifications and the private messages a user received. Mark the notifications as read when you are done.
